# French Poulet Club

> French rotisserie chicken counter in Stockholm, Sweden. Chicken marinated 24 hours and oven-roasted, French sides and sauces, served with fast-food speed. No pork. Opening spring 2028. Short name: FPC.

## Key facts

- Name: French Poulet Club (FPC)
- What: French-style roast chicken, eat in or take away
- Where: Stockholm, Sweden (exact address to be announced)
- When: opening spring 2028
- Language on site and menu: English, with a few well-known French words (bon appétit, merci, voilà, oui chef)
- Diet: no pork on the menu
- Website: __SITE__/

## Menu (prices in SEK, VAT included; may change before opening)

### Chicken (oven roasted, marinated 24 h)
- 3 Drumsticks: 49
- Whole leg (thigh & drumstick): 55
- Breast (skin on): 59
- Half chicken: 99
- Whole chicken (to share): 179

### Meals
- Classic (any chicken, 1 side, 1 sauce): 125
- Classic + drink: 149
- Classic + drink + dessert: 175
- Student (with student card): 110
- Family deal (whole chicken, 3 sides, 2 sauces): 239

### Sides (39 each)
- Pan-fried potatoes
- Creamy pasta
- Green beans

### Sauces (12 each)
- Green, onion, mayo

### More
- Gratin dauphinois: 49
- Croque-monsieur: price to be announced
- Cordon bleu: price to be announced
- Tiramisu: 49
- Soft drink: 20

## Questions people ask

- Is there pork? No, the menu has no pork.
- Is the chicken fried? No. It is marinated for 24 hours and roasted in the oven.
- Where is it? In Stockholm, Sweden. The exact address will be announced before opening.
- When does it open? Spring 2028.
- Is there a student price? Yes, the Student meal is 110 SEK with a student card.
- Is there a loyalty card? Yes, a club card for Apple Wallet and Google Wallet. Details at opening.
- Can I order a whole chicken to share? Yes, 179 SEK, or the Family deal at 239 SEK.
